candidate_arms.single_change: Reject a new entry when the timestamp-valid executable ask exceeds 0.25.
Cap worst-case entry notional per independent event lifecycle at 10 USD; quantity is min(baseline quantity, floor(10/executable ask), displayed executable depth).
At the first later timestamp-valid book with sufficient executable bid depth, exit when executable bid is at or below 75% of entry price.

evidence_eligibility.fill_model: walk contemporaneous captured asks for buys and bids for sells; never midpoint or later mark
evidence_eligibility.slippage_policy: captured depth walk plus registered conservative latency penalty; no zero-cost fallback

promotion_gates.confidence_rule: 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound for candidate net expectancy and paired uplift must both exceed 0 after Holm correction across the three registered arms
promotion_gates.live_transition: requires a separate explicit user decision and new safety review; this protocol never authorizes live trading

current_hard_blockers: Frozen historical X sample has zero executable completed legs.
Public-record pipeline has zero net-capturable markouts.
Immutable strategy copy/hash operation is pending explicit filesystem consent.
